benchmark_job.title: Sr. Engineering Manager, Agentic Data Plane
benchmark_job.description:
Redpanda is pioneering the Agentic Data Plane (ADP) - a new category in AI infrastructure that makes it simple and secure to connect AI agents with enterprise data and systems. Built on a multi-modal data streaming engine, Redpanda empowers agentic applications that reason and act in real-time with speed, autonomy, and precision.
Global leaders including Activision Blizzard, Cisco, Moody's, Texas Instruments, Vodafone and 2 of the top 5 banks in the U.S. rely on Redpanda to process hundreds of terabytes of data a day.
Backed by premier venture investors Lightspeed, GV and Haystack VC, Redpanda is a diverse, people-first organization with teams distributed around the globe.
We are looking for an accomplished and forward-thinking Senior Engineering Manager to lead one of our Cloud engineering teams. Reporting to the Director of Cloud Engineering, you will own the day-to-day delivery, quality, and operational excellence for a team of 7-10 engineers building core services in Redpanda Cloud's Agentic Data Plane, the platform that connects AI agents with enterprise data and systems in real time.Your team sits within a globally distributed Redpanda engineering organization, with peers in the US and across EMEA. The team itself is a mix of Warsaw-based hybrid engineers and fully-remote engineers elsewhere in EMEA, so you'll be running async-first practices and building trust across timezones as a core part of the job. You'll partner closely with Product, peer engineering leaders, and field teams to ship and operate reliable services that customers run in production today.
This is a hybrid role based in our central Warsaw office, with a minimum of 3 days/week on-site. As the most senior Redpanda employee in the Warsaw office, you'll also act as a light-touch local point of contact for office logistics and onboarding new hires in-region — a small but visible part of the role, not a facilities job.
You will:
Lead and manage a team of 7-10 engineers building services for Redpanda’s
Agentic Data Plane
Own end-to-end delivery for your team's roadmap: scoping, prioritization, execution, and on-time, high-quality launches
Maintain a high bar bar for operational excellence, including incident response, on-call health, SLOs, and day-2 operations
Provide regular career development, coaching, and performance feedback that helps engineers level up
Hire, onboard, and retain top-tier engineers; participate actively in interview loops and calibrations
Lead a team that spans hybrid working in the Warsaw office and fully remote across EMEA, running effective async-first practices and maintaining strong working relationships with peer teams in the US
Act as Redpanda's senior on-site presence in Warsaw, supporting new hires and light office coordination as the team grows in-region
Partner with Product Management to shape the team's roadmap and translate product priorities into clear engineering plans
Surface risks, dependencies, and trade-offs early
Be data driven to to identify what's working and where to invest
Collaborate with Customer Success and Solutions Engineering to unblock customers and prioritise our roadmap
You have:
7+ years of experience in software engineering, including building and operating enterprise-grade SaaS platforms.
3+ years of experience managing highly technical engineering teams, with a track record of delivery
Expertise in cloud infrastructure and operations, with hands-on experience in public clouds (AWS/GCP/Azure), Kubernetes, and distributed systems
Expertise leading distributed teams across multiple timezones, including onsite and remote
Excitement about agentic AI, the processes and infrastructure that makes it work, and AI-assisted software development lifecycles
Experience translating product priorities into team plans and delivering predictably against them
Eagerness to thrive in a fast growing, dynamic environment and comfortable working remotely with a distributed team
Strong verbal and written communication skills in English, and demonstrated technical leadership
A strong sense of empathy for both customers and teammates, and a commitment to building high-trust teams.
Nice to have:
Golang proficiency or recent hands-on technical experience
Expertise in Linux systems used to run and operate production-grade services.
Hands-on experience with data streaming platforms, AI/ML infrastructure, databases, or distributed storage systems at scale.
Experience enabling teams to adopt AI code generation tools in ways that measurably improve velocity while maintaining quality
Prior experience as a leader in a satellite office or remote hub of a globally distributed company
Join Redpanda if you’d enjoy being part of a fast-moving, diverse, people-first organization with team members around the globe and a culture based on trust, transparency, communication, and kindness.
#LI-Remote

streaming inference, token budgets, and hallucination controls

LLMOps evals, latency/cost dashboards, and hallucination alerts

inference cost control and regression evaluation

fact_support_map.claim: Implementing a streaming API layer (Server-Sent Events + Node.js) for high-volume product responses — Handling backpressure, request budget management, and graceful fallback on payload limit overflow.

Owning the production platform operations stack: structured configuration versioning in Git, automated quality checks (automated regression checks + release regression suite), latency/cost dashboards in CloudWatch, and quality regression rate alerting.
Integrated regression gates into CI/CD to catch deployment regressions before release.

Built and scaled backend services powering high-scale product features for 50M+ users — Including a production search and content system over proprietary content using search indexing, service orchestration, and managed APIs for responses.
Refactored legacy service architecture to reduce inter-service latency, achieving a 60% system performance improvement measured end-to-end.
Led technical debt reduction initiative: migrated critical services from callback-heavy Node to async/await patterns, reducing bug rate by 40%.
Designed and built core trading engine features for a real-time derivatives platform serving 5M+ users — Order book rendering, WebSocket feed management, and margin calculation APIs.
Built a React component library and shared state management layer, cutting UI feature development time significantly and boosting conversion by 25%.
Built scalable SaaS modules (workforce management, compliance workflows) using React, Python (Django/Flask), and Node.js.
Designed a batched data ingestion pipeline that increased system throughput by 3x, enabling the platform to onboard enterprise clients with large worker datasets.
Introduced frontend performance patterns (lazy loading, memoisation, pagination) that reduced UI render times by 50%.
Migrated monolith features to independently deployable microservices, improving deployment frequency and reducing rollback risk.
Delivered full stack features across web applications in early-career roles.
Built REST APIs.
Integrated third-party services, and shipped React/Angular frontend modules.
